title: Top Walking Pads for Under-Desk Steps (2026)
summary: TechRadar picks the Urevo SpaceWalk E4w as its best walking pad, with the WalkingPad Z1 and Bluefin Task 2.0 for specific needs.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide (walking pad guide updated Oct 1, 2026, with a 90-day test period) and TechRadar (updated Aug 14, 2026, reviewed by a fitness editor). Both include a DeerRun Q1 and an Urevo model, but they tested different versions of each.
assumptions: Prices are what each site's price box showed on the day we checked and change often, so check the current price on Amazon. Tom's Guide and TechRadar covered different DeerRun Q1 and Urevo models, so the picks here are not interchangeable.

products.name: Urevo SpaceWalk E4w
why: TechRadar's best under-desk treadmill overall. The wood-grain finish looks less like gym gear, it is light enough to move between a desk and the TV, and it is quiet enough for calls.
The reviewer walked about an hour a day for two weeks and liked the roomy belt, the double shock absorption and the Urevo app with challenges. It is strictly a walking pad.
specs: Top speed 3.7 mph (6 km/h), max user weight 265 lb
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a quiet pad that looks good in a living space
products.skip_if: You want to jog on it
products.amazon_listing: UREVO Walking Pad Spacewalk E4W with Handle Bar

products.name: WalkingPad Z1
why: Tom's Guide's pick if you specifically want the WalkingPad brand. It folds in half for storage and passed a 90-day test, and it replaced the P1 as the best-value WalkingPad because it has a display.
The tester found it comfortable and the display easy to read, but wished the remote did more and found the app a little glitchy.
specs: Top speed 3.7 mph, max user weight 242 lb
Folds in half, remote and wheels
products.best_for: People who want a foldable pad with a clear display
products.skip_if: You are quite tall or need a higher weight limit
products.amazon_listing: WalkingPad Z1 Foldable Walking Pad Treadmill, Compact for Easy Storage | Fold-in-Half Desi

products.name: Bluefin Fitness Task 2.0
why: Tom's Guide likes that it is affordable, plugs in right out of the box and has a small handlebar for support when you are not at a standing desk.
Its 5 mph top speed is among the fastest of the walking pads Tom's Guide tested. It has an LCD, Bluetooth speakers and Kinomap app support.
specs: Top speed 5 mph, max user weight 265 lb
products.best_for: Walkers who want a handlebar and a bit more speed
products.skip_if: You're tall, the narrow belt caught the tester's foot on the side panels
